n: TERC Data Clubs middle school data science activities
t: Three data science modules where middle schoolers explore topics they care about.
steps: Find the TERC Data Clubs page and read the three module pages.
Download the activity materials for one module.
Check which tools the activities need. The main page does not name them.
Ask IT to confirm that the tools run on school devices.
Confirm that the project is still supported. A search snippet says it is no longer active.
Preview the datasets for sensitive topics.
Choose a module that fits your students.
